|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Jedi Levitation (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-jedilevitation022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Jedi Levitation”. Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a non-[Maintenance] character into hand.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jedi Levitation (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-jedilevitationab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a non-[Maintenance] character into hand.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jedi Levitation (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-jedilevitation12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/jedilevitation.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the game text was rewritten (compare the texts below); the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Jedi Levitation”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, choose: Take that card into hand. OR Cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, use 4 Force to take a character into hand from Lost Pile.”
